setup.title: Welcome to RITE
setup.subtitle: Create your master password to secure your connections
setup.warning: Important: This password cannot be recovered. Keep it safe.

unlock.title: RITE
unlock.subtitle: Enter your master password to unlock
unlock.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} second(s).
unlock.securityNote: Your data is encrypted and stored locally
unlock.resetMessage: Resetting will delete ALL your saved connections.
unlock.resetConfirmLabel: Type DELETE ALL DATA to confirm:

main.noConnectionsHint: Start by creating a new SSH connection
main.welcomeSubtitle: Your secure terminal client for managing SSH connections
main.step1: Create a new SSH connection in the sidebar
main.step2: Enter your server information (host, port, username)
main.step3: Connect by double-clicking on the connection
main.securityMessage: All your connections are encrypted locally with your master password. Your data never leaves your machine.

connections.title: Connection Details
connections.name: Connection Name
connections.authAgentIdentityHint: Pin one to present only that key to the server (less fingerprint exposure). Default offers all, like ssh.
connections.authAgentNoneHint: Start one and add a key — eval "$(ssh-agent)" then ssh-add — then reopen this dialog.
connections.authAgentNote: Rite asks the agent to sign — your key and passphrase never leave it, and nothing is stored in Rite. Hardware keys (YubiKey/FIDO) work only this way.
connections.authAgentForwardHint: Lets the remote machine reuse your local keys to hop onward. Powerful but risky — leave off unless you need it.
connections.keyPassphrasePlaceholder: Enter passphrase if key is encrypted...
connections.collectionMoveUnsupported: Moving a machine between collections isn't supported yet.
connections.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this connection?
connections.keyFileHint: Read in this page and stored in your encrypted vault — it is never uploaded as a file. Terminals here run on the server, so a path on your computer would mean nothing to it.
connections.keyFileLoaded: Loaded from {name}. It is encrypted with your vault key before it leaves this page.
connections.keyUnreadable: That file could not be read.
connections.keyLooksPublic: That looks like a public key (.pub). Choose the private key — the file without the extension.
connections.keyRememberWhy: Otherwise it is asked each time you connect. Kept here it rides with the key it protects, so it stops being a second barrier.
connections.keyRememberOff: Your server does not keep passphrases
connections.keyRememberOffWhy: — you will be asked for it each time you connect.
connections.passphraseAskWhy: Used for this connection only. Rite is not keeping it — tick “Remember this passphrase” when editing the machine if you would rather it did.
connections.keyPassphraseStored: A passphrase is stored for this key. Leave this empty to keep it, type a new one to replace it, or untick below to have Rite forget it.
connections.keyRememberForget: Stored. Untick to have Rite forget it — you will be asked for it at each connection instead.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoLockEnabledDesc: Automatically lock the application after a period of inactivity
settings.clipboardClearEnabledDesc: Automatically clear clipboard after 30 seconds for security
settings.hostKeyVerificationDesc: Configure how unknown SSH server keys are handled
settings.splitsHint: A divider opens a plain terminal — that is the split button, and it stays that way. What else it can open, from the chevron beside it, is yours to set: a named command, kept in your workspace file beside your layouts.
settings.toolbarHint: What sits along the top of the window. Hiding a button never changes what you're allowed to do — the keyboard shortcut and the menus still reach it, and what your server forbids stays forbidden.
settings.toolbarShellDesc: The dropdown beside New Terminal, for the shell a new local terminal opens. Hiding it leaves the setting itself in Settings ▸ Terminals.
settings.toolbarNewTermMenuDesc: The chevron on the + beside the tabs, to open one terminal with another shell without changing your default. Hiding it leaves + opening the default shell.
settings.toolbarFocusDesc: The F11 button. The key works either way.
settings.toolbarQuickSshDesc: One-off connections that aren't saved in a collection.
settings.toolbarLayoutsDesc: The button beside the tabs. It already hides itself when you have no layouts.
settings.shellHint: What a new local terminal opens. This is the same setting as the picker in the toolbar — changing it either way changes both.
settings.shellServerDesc: Set by your administrator for every terminal on this server. Desktop users pick their own local shell.
settings.shellYoursDesc: Among the shells this server has installed. Saved in this browser, so another browser starts on the instance default again.
settings.shellServerHint: Terminals run on the server here, so the shell is the server’s to set — not a per-user preference.
settings.shellCustom: A shell we didn't find (full path)
settings.toolbarQuickSshOffWhy: , so the button stays hidden whatever this says.
settings.hostKeyServerDesc: Set by your administrator for every connection this server opens.

sshKeepAlive.label: SSH Keep-Alive
sshKeepAlive.description: Configure connection health monitoring for this server

snip.title: Snippets
snip.subtitle: Run a saved command on {pane}, or ⇉ broadcast to every open pane.
snip.empty: No snippets yet — add one below.
snip.name: Name
snip.fillAll: Give the snippet a name and at least one command.

split.more: Split with… — a preset or a snippet
split.title: Splits
split.subtitle: A divider opens a plain terminal. What else it can open is yours to set.
split.name: Name
split.layoutsTitle: Layouts — open a saved arrangement in this tab

pf.title: Port forwarding
pf.empty: No forwards yet — add one below.
pf.fillAll: Fill local port, remote host and remote port.
pf.hint: A local forward: anything reaching 127.0.0.1:localport on your machine is tunnelled over SSH to remotehost:remoteport as seen from {name} (through its jump host too, if it has one). Remote & dynamic (SOCKS) coming soon.
pf.unsupportedHere: Port forwards are not available in this context

jump.label: Jump host
jump.hint: Reach this machine through another (a bastion). Rite opens the jump first, then tunnels the SSH session to the target — like OpenSSH ProxyJump. Chainable: if the jump itself has a jump, the whole path is built. Your key never lands on the bastion.

dash.detectNote: Cards are what Rite detects on this host — surfaced automatically, agentless (over the SSH session, through the jump host if any).
dash.noRuntime: No docker or podman on this host.
dash.containersHint: docker/podman ps over SSH · agentless. Shell opens a pane running exec -it.
dash.unavailable: Detection isn't available in this context.
dash.customizeHint: Choose which cards appear on {name}'s dashboard. Containers & Services are detected live over SSH; hide what you don't need.
dash.probesOffTitle: Containers and services are not being checked
dash.probesOffWebui: Your server turns off container and service checks in the web UI, so they run for nobody here.
dash.probesOffClients: Your server turns off container and service checks for this client.
dash.probesOffYou: Container and service checks are off in your settings.
dash.probesOffYouHint: Turn them back on in Settings. Everything else on this dashboard is unaffected.

board.title: Board
board.intro: A members-only space for {name} — links, notes, one-click actions and live views. Encrypted; write access can edit. Click a card to open it.
board.introLocal: A space of cards for {name} — links, notes, one-click actions and live views. Encrypted in your vault. Click a card to open it.
board.empty: No cards yet — add a Link, Note, Action or Live view.
board.emptyFiltered: No cards in this category — add one.
board.readonly: Read-only — you don't have write access to this collection.
board.fieldDescHint: run a snippet / open a TUI / connect
board.liveEmpty: No data yet — refreshes from a connected machine.

preconnect.label: Pre-connect command
preconnect.placeholder:
wg-quick up wg0
# one line, or a mini-script (fail-fast)
preconnect.hint: Runs locally before the SSH session opens — bring up a VPN, refresh an SSO token. A non-zero exit cancels the connection.
preconnect.title: Running pre-connect
preconnect.failed: Pre-connect failed — the connection was cancelled.

shortcuts.hint: Click a shortcut, then press the keys you want. {mod} is the command modifier on this machine, and the same binding follows you to the other.
shortcuts.conflictTitle: Another command uses this chord, so one of the two never fires.
shortcuts.conflictNote: Two commands share a chord. Both are saved, but only one of them will fire.
shortcuts.reserved: {chord} belongs to the terminal — it is copy or paste.

close.label: Close pane
close.description: Closes the focused pane, asking first if it holds live sessions.

splitHorizontal.label: Split horizontally
splitHorizontal.description: Opens a plain terminal beside the focused pane.

splitVertical.label: Split vertically
splitVertical.description: Opens a plain terminal below the focused pane.

search.label: Search in pane
search.description: Opens the find bar over the focused terminal.

fixed.focusMode: Focus mode — hide the toolbar so terminals fill the screen. Esc or F11 to leave.
fixed.dismiss: Dismiss the find bar, or an open dialog.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.subtitle: What opens when you sit down
layouts.lede: Which terminals open, in what order, and on which machines. It is a file, so you can keep it in version control and carry it between computers. A machine this computer doesn't have opens a plain shell with a note in the pane — the rest of the layout still opens.
layouts.noPath: This instance did not say where the file is.
layouts.keptRunning: The layouts already loaded keep working until the file parses again.
layouts.fileHasError: Your layouts file has an error
layouts.fellBackLocked: {machine} needs an open vault — your machines are encrypted, so this pane opened a plain shell.
layouts.fellBackMissing: {machine} isn't in your library — renamed, or from another computer. This pane opened a plain shell.
layouts.fellBackPreconnect: {machine}'s pre-connect hook did not pass, so this pane opened a plain shell.
layouts.fellBackFailed: {machine} would not open ({why}), so this pane opened a plain shell.
layouts.startupHint: Tick “at startup” and the layout opens itself when Rite starts — several may, each in its own tabs. The switch writes startup into the file.
layouts.noneYet: No layouts yet. Open the file and describe what should open when you sit down.

auth.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
auth.passwordTooShort: A master password needs at least {count} characters.
auth.setupFailed: The vault could not be created: {error}
auth.unlockFailed: The vault could not be unlocked: {error}
auth.lockFailed: The vault could not be locked: {error}
